chunks: The one who buys a muhaffala and returns it, let him return a ssaa’ with it.

It was only named muhaffala because the milk was subject to tahfeel and accumulated in its udder. Everything that you increase, you would have performed tahfeel to it. It is from it that it was said: «The people assembled » if they gather and increase. It was for this that an assembly of the people was named, and the plural of an assembly is assemblies .

key_terms.حَفِلَ: To accumulate, gather, or become abundant
key_terms.صَاع: A traditional unit of volume measurement used in Islamic jurisprudence
key_terms.مَحْفَل: An assembly or gathering of people
key_terms.مُحَفَّلَة: A young cow or heifer with milk still in its udder, used in trade contexts

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling and linguistic meaning of returning a 'muhaffala' in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq elucidates the fiqh of 'gharar' (uncertainty) in sales) by detailing the specific compensation required when returning a 'muhaffala', a young cow with milk still in its udder. The text provides etymological depth, linking the term to 'hafala' (accumulation), thereby highlighting the linguistic precision used by early jurists to define the physical state of the commodity and the extent of its inherent uncertainty.
